## Rebel organization activity by country

Pick a country to see the monthly event count for every rebel organization
active there (UCDP GED state-based conflicts), showing how each
organization's activity has escalated or de-escalated over time.

```{r build-data}
library(rebeltrack)
library(dplyr)
library(crosstalk)
library(plotly)

dataset <- rebeltrack_load_dataset(type = UCDP_STATE_BASED)

data <- rebeltrack_dataframe(dataset,
                             side = SIDE_B,
                             period = "month",
                             balanced = TRUE) %>%
  rebeltrack_event_count(event_count) %>%
  rebeltrack_actor_name(actor_name)

df <- as.data.frame(data)

# rebeltrack_dataframe()'s panel is grouped by actor only - country isn't
# carried through, so it's attached separately from the raw events. An actor
# can be attributed to more than one country (e.g. a group active on both
# sides of a border); when that happens they'll appear under each relevant
# country, which is the desired behaviour here.
actor_countries <- dataset@events %>%
  dplyr::distinct(side_b_new_id, country) %>%
  dplyr::rename(actor = side_b_new_id)

df <- df %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(actor_countries, by = "actor") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(country))

# Keep only actor/country pairs with a meaningful amount of activity, so the
# country dropdown isn't cluttered with one-off or miscoded entries.
keep <- df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(actor, country) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(total_events = sum(event_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(total_events >= 5)

df <- df %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(keep, by = c("actor", "country")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(country, actor_name, period_start)

# UCDP's raw text fields (country/actor names) include accented characters
# that aren't always cleanly UTF-8 encoded in the source data - plotly's JSON
# serialization errors ("input string 1 is invalid UTF-8") on that. Round-
# tripping through iconv(from = "UTF-8", to = "UTF-8") validates the input as
# UTF-8 and drops anything that isn't, which sanitizes it without needing to
# know the true source encoding.
fix_utf8 <- function(x) iconv(x, from = "UTF-8", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
df$country <- fix_utf8(df$country)
df$actor_name <- fix_utf8(df$actor_name)
```

```{r chart}
shared <- SharedData$new(df, group = "rebeltrack-country")

bscols(
  widths = c(3, 3, 6),
  filter_select("country", "Country", shared, ~country),
  filter_select("actor", "Rebel organization", shared, ~actor_name),
  plot_ly(shared, x = ~period_start, y = ~event_count, color = ~actor_name,
          type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
          hoverinfo = "text",
          text = ~paste0(actor_name, "<br>", format(period_start, "%b %Y"),
                         "<br>Events: ", event_count)) %>%
    layout(xaxis = list(title = ""),
           yaxis = list(title = "Events per month"),
           legend = list(orientation = "h"))
)
```

```{r cascade-js, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
# crosstalk's filter_select() widgets only filter the *chart* they're linked
# to - they don't restrict each other's own dropdown lists (each filter's
# option list is fixed at render time from the full dataset). To make the
# "Rebel organization" dropdown only offer orgs present in the selected
# country, we bypass crosstalk here and drive it with plain selectize.js:
# listen for changes on the country filter's underlying <select>, and
# rebuild the actor filter's option list from a country -> actors lookup
# built from the same df used above.
country_actors <- df %>%
  dplyr::distinct(country, actor_name) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(country, actor_name)

country_actors_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  split(country_actors$actor_name, country_actors$country)
)

cat(sprintf('
<script>
(function() {
  var countryActors = %s;
  var allActors = Array.from(new Set([].concat.apply([], Object.values(countryActors)))).sort();

  function getSelectize(divId) {
    var el = document.querySelector("#" + divId + " select");
    return (el && el.selectize) ? el.selectize : null;
  }

  function actorsForCountries(countries) {
    if (!countries || countries.length === 0) return allActors;
    var set = new Set();
    countries.forEach(function(c) {
      (countryActors[c] || []).forEach(function(a) { set.add(a); });
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }

  function getPlotlyDiv() {
    return document.querySelector(".js-plotly-plot");
  }

  function updateActorOptions(countries) {
    var actorSelectize = getSelectize("actor");
    if (!actorSelectize) return;
    var actors = actorsForCountries(countries);
    var current = actorSelectize.getValue();
    actorSelectize.clearOptions();
    actors.forEach(function(a) { actorSelectize.addOption({value: a, label: a}); });
    actorSelectize.refreshOptions(false);
    var stillValid = current.filter(function(v) { return actors.indexOf(v) !== -1; });
    // silent: the legend refresh is triggered explicitly by the caller below,
    // so we do not need setValue()\'s own change event to fire here too.
    actorSelectize.setValue(stillValid, true);
  }

  // crosstalk empties out a trace\'s data points when it is filtered, but
  // leaves the (now-empty) trace, and thus its legend entry, in place. This
  // drives the legend directly off the current country/actor selection so
  // traces that are not currently shown drop out of the legend entirely.
  function applyLegendFilter() {
    var countrySelectize = getSelectize("country");
    var actorSelectize = getSelectize("actor");
    var graphDiv = getPlotlyDiv();
    if (!countrySelectize || !actorSelectize || !graphDiv || !graphDiv.data) return;

    var countries = countrySelectize.getValue();
    var selectedActors = actorSelectize.getValue();
    var allowed = selectedActors.length > 0 ? selectedActors : actorsForCountries(countries);
    var allowedSet = new Set(allowed);

    var visible = graphDiv.data.map(function(trace) {
      return allowedSet.has(trace.name);
    });

    Plotly.restyle(graphDiv, { visible: visible });
  }

  function onCountryChange() {
    var countrySelectize = getSelectize("country");
    updateActorOptions(countrySelectize.getValue());
    applyLegendFilter();
  }

  function init() {
    var countrySelectize = getSelectize("country");
    var actorSelectize = getSelectize("actor");
    var graphDiv = getPlotlyDiv();
    if (!countrySelectize || !actorSelectize || !graphDiv || !graphDiv.data || !graphDiv.data.length) {
      setTimeout(init, 150);
      return;
    }
    updateActorOptions(countrySelectize.getValue());
    applyLegendFilter();
    countrySelectize.on("change", onCountryChange);
    actorSelectize.on("change", applyLegendFilter);
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
', country_actors_json))
```
